skill.name: sitemapkit
skill.description: Use SitemapKit to discover website sitemap files, extract sitemap URLs, and run full sitemap crawls through the SitemapKit MCP server.
skill.summary: Discover sitemap files and extract website URL lists with SitemapKit.
skill.author: 0nl1n1n

security_audit.summary: The static scan produced many false positives from Markdown backticks, package metadata, and documentation examples. The main contextual risk is that the MCP server forwards user-supplied domains or sitemap URLs to a fixed external SitemapKit API for discovery and crawling. No prompt injection attempt, credential harvesting, or hidden local filesystem access was found.

remediation.issue: Arbitrary target URLs are forwarded to an external crawling service.
remediation.suggestion: Document this data flow clearly and require users to confirm they are authorized to crawl each target.

remediation.issue: Local URL validation is minimal before requests are sent to SitemapKit.
remediation.suggestion: Validate URL schemes and reject localhost, private IP ranges, and internal hostnames before calling the API.

remediation.issue: The skill depends on a user-provided API key.
remediation.suggestion: Keep the key in environment configuration only and avoid placing real keys in prompts, logs, or shared config files.

semantic_findings.description: The skill accepts user-supplied domains or sitemap URLs and forwards them to SitemapKit for discovery, extraction, or full crawl. This is legitimate SEO functionality, but it can disclose target URLs to a third party and support reconnaissance of arbitrary websites.

content.value_statement: Website audits need complete URL lists, but sitemaps are often split across files. SitemapKit connects your assistant to tools that discover sitemaps, extract URLs, and report crawl limits.
actual_capabilities: Find sitemap files for a domain through SitemapKit discovery.
Extract URL entries from a specific sitemap file.
Run a full crawl across discovered sitemap files.
Return URL metadata such as last modified dates when available.
Report truncation status and remaining SitemapKit quota.
limitations: Requires a valid SitemapKit API key in the environment.
Sends requested domains and sitemap URLs to the SitemapKit API.
Results are limited by the active SitemapKit plan and max URL setting.
Does not verify that the user owns or controls the target website.

use_cases.title: Prepare SEO URL Inventories
use_cases.description: Collect sitemap URLs before an SEO audit, migration, or crawl comparison.

use_cases.title: Review Published Site Structure
use_cases.description: Inspect page groups, sitemap indexes, and URL coverage for a public website.

use_cases.title: Seed Website Data Pipelines
use_cases.description: Generate URL lists for monitoring, indexing, or downstream analysis tasks.

prompt_templates.title: Find Sitemaps
prompt_templates.prompt: Find all sitemap files for https://example.com and summarize where each sitemap was discovered.

prompt_templates.title: Extract One Sitemap
prompt_templates.prompt: Extract the URLs from https://example.com/sitemap.xml and include last modified dates when available.

prompt_templates.title: Audit URL Coverage
prompt_templates.prompt: Run a full sitemap crawl for https://example.com with a 5000 URL limit. Report the total count, truncation status, and notable URL groups.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Migration Targets
prompt_templates.prompt: Discover sitemaps for the old and new domains I provide, then compare URL counts, missing sections, and crawl limits.

output_examples.input: Find all sitemaps for a public marketing site.
output: Identifies whether discovery came from robots.txt, common paths, or an index file.
Shows remaining monthly quota when the API reports it.

output_examples.input: Extract a blog sitemap before a content audit.
output: Returns the page URLs from the sitemap.
Includes last modified dates when the sitemap provides them.
Notes whether the result was truncated by the requested limit.

output_examples.input: Crawl all sitemaps for a product documentation domain.
output: Reports sitemap files discovered and processed.
Groups returned URLs for review outside the assistant when needed.

best_practices: Use full public URLs with the correct protocol.
Set a clear max URL limit before large crawls.
Warn users when quota is low or results are truncated.
anti_patterns: Do not crawl private, internal, or unauthorized targets.
Do not assume sitemap URLs represent every live page.
Do not expose the SitemapKit API key in prompts, logs, or shared files.

faq.question: Does this skill require an account?
faq.answer: Yes. It requires a SitemapKit API key configured as an environment variable.

faq.question: Can it discover sitemaps automatically?
faq.answer: Yes. The discovery tool checks known sitemap locations and sitemap indexes through the SitemapKit API.

faq.question: Can it extract URLs from one sitemap file?
faq.answer: Yes. Provide the exact sitemap URL and the skill returns URL entries from that file.

faq.question: Can it crawl a complete site?
faq.answer: It can run a full sitemap crawl, subject to plan limits and the requested max URL value.

faq.question: Where are requested URLs sent?
faq.answer: Requested domains and sitemap URLs are sent to the SitemapKit API for processing.

faq.question: Does it check website ownership?
faq.answer: No. Users should only crawl targets they are authorized to inspect.
